🦠 Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) can cause severe illness in vulnerable groups. No vaccine or treatment means infection prevention is crucial.

Learn how hand hygiene, disinfection & self-sanitizing surfaces can help:https://t.co/jw9AwY4g
